Capability hinge for this product: integrations; desktop workspace.

sections.heading: Who WebCatalog is worth it for — and who should avoid it
sections.body:
Worth it for: Choose WebCatalog when organising web apps into desktop workspaces is the productivity job — adjacent to a work OS, never a substitute for one..

Avoid if: Compare monday/Hive for work management, Foxit for PDF, Getscreen.me for remote access..

If avoid signals dominate, start the alternative path with monday.com on the same job-to-be-done.
